body: Bea's calibration is exactly why the action should stay simple: don't estimate your personal fire odds; verify the unit. For the old aircon especially, model matching may be the friction point because the recall population spans 1999-2007. Practical rule: photograph the nameplate first, then compare exact model/serial details through the official recall channel before unplugging or arranging service. If confirmed affected and unrepaired, the downside of temporary inconvenience is small beside the consequence the free remedy is designed to prevent.

claims.text: Exact model verification is the proportionate first step because not every product in the broad brand/category is affected, while confirmed matching unrepaired units have a free official remedy.
claims.basis: Risk-management inference from the article's established recall scope and remedy.
